questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears on screen and in my notes?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
In one sentence: what do you help people with, and who are they?
What is your accent colour (the one colour used for the key word, the focal element and the glow)?
(saved with the accent colour) the plain word for it: blue, gold, lime
Which font do you use for headlines?
(found on their computer) the bold weight of the main font
(found on their computer) the regular or medium weight of the main font; left unset, the bold is reused
Do you want key words in a second, contrasting font, or the same font in your colour?
(found on their computer) the emphasis font; the shipped Playfair Display Italic if they have no preference
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (recommended, the most accurate word timings) or on this computer (free)?
Where should finished videos go? Next to the raw file in an '- Edit' folder is the default.
questions.default: beside the raw file, in a "<video name> - Edit" folder

questions.ask: Is your raw footage on an external drive? Which one?
Do you have a sound-effects pack (whooshes, pops, clicks)? Tell me the folder.
questions.default: none yet (videos are delivered without sound effects)

questions.ask: Where do you keep music you are allowed to use?
Should I always ask before adding music, or add a favourite and tell you which?
Where do you keep the real things I can show on screen: client results, testimonials, screenshots?
Where do your raw long-form recordings live? I look there first when you name a video.
Do you have a logo file I can use? Drop it into the chat. (Saved as logo.png in the creator profile's assets folder.)
And a wide wordmark (your name or brand written out) that works on a dark background? Optional. (Saved as wordmark.png.)
Should your logo sit in the corner of the whole video as a watermark, or only appear where a graphic calls for it?
questions.default: only where a graphic calls for it, never a constant watermark

questions.ask: Besides your proof folder, are there other folders I should search for real things to show: client work, brand assets, B-roll, screenshots?
When you name a company, a person, a website or a video, may I fetch the real logo, photo, screenshot or thumbnail from the web? Rights are yours to manage; I list every source.
questions.default: yes: real over drawn, every source listed in the report

questions.ask: Is there anything that must never be shown on screen: names, clients, competitors, figures, old offers, topics?
How tight should the dialogue edit be? Pauses longer than this many seconds are shortened.
...and they are shortened to this many seconds (never removed).
Breaths between sentences: keep them (natural) or cut them (tighter)?
How strong should a punch-in on your face be, as a percentage? 112 is a clear but gentle cut-in.
Depth and 3D in graphics (cards separating through depth, frames resting at a slight angle): on or off?
Captions: none, or a caption file to upload to YouTube? Nothing is burned into the picture.
Master resolution: 1080p, or 4K (only worth it when you film in 4K; renders take several times longer)?
Should I run the whole edit to the end and then report every asset and wording choice, or stop and ask at each stage (the cut, the plan, the draft)?
questions.default: run to the end, then report
